Is free sampling bringing us scale?

Built on the "Jars/ Boxes" free-giveaway category (confirmed near-zero invoiced value against the raw ledger) — the paid "Sampling Jar" product is real revenue and counts as ordinary paid business everywhere here, including this tab. Cohorts are indexed to each distributor's own first order, and ignore the date range above (a cohort needs its full life to date) but respect state / zone / tier / distributor search.

Where we sample vs. where paid growth is happening

By zone — free units sampled, distributors sampled, and the paid-revenue growth rate in that zone over the selected period
